checks: 12-block nested workflow imported with exact topology, group, positions and viewport
AND to OR to NOT preserves the entire nested tree; one-step undo restores each operation
GUI candidate-list and numeric-operator edits retain existing values
valid YAML comments and formatting survive view switches, file export, undo and redo
GUI to JSON to GUI to YAML preserves nested predicates, layout and every edge
invalid text stays recoverable and exportable, locks conflicting edits, and can be repaired without graph loss
injected delayed validation response cannot overwrite a newer invalid text edit
six real API simulations cover nested AND/OR/NOT yes/no/unknown, explicit all-merge, delay, overnight quiet hours, exclusion date, limit and aggregation
invalid simulator JSON cannot evaluate an old event and survives switching input modes
GUI schedule edits change the simulator due time while preserving quiet hours
GUI insertion of an asymmetric branch distinguishes all-merge from any-merge without duplicate output
URL-only display uses the original URL with no second expansion
collapsed groups can be focused by block selector and opened with persistent layout state
fragment export, duplicate and file import remap IDs and internal edges, use distinct positions and require explicit reconnection
single-block duplicate is selected and focused, and undo/redo preserves detached-draft validity
keyboard delete and one undo restore the node and all its connections together
Delete cannot remove the start block or its outgoing connections
keyboard selection and deletion of an edge is undoable without losing other topology
keyboard block movement has an undo checkpoint
pointer drag gesture is restored by one undo without intermediate position checkpoints
Shift multi-selection creates a group and ungrouping preserves every node and edge
malformed fragment import reports its external edge and preserves the current graph
DST repeated hour chooses the earliest instant and a partially missing window retains its real portion
fixed DST quiet-hour boundary defers local 03:30 to 04:00 through GUI/API
published-time delay with unavailable publication time remains unknown and cannot satisfy an all-merge
GUI permits multiple aggregates and limits before/after them; JSON/YAML roundtrip preserves every stage and connection order (runtime semantics owned by parent)
saved complex rule exports as a package and reimports as a draft with topology, settings and layout intact
complex nested-condition studio remains operable without page overflow at 390px
uxChecks: compact operator summary and collapsible outline retain unknown semantics and one selected editor without changing the predicate
Delete/Backspace in condition navigation and tool controls cannot delete the selected graph block
adding a child opens only that new condition; deleting it returns to its parent without affecting siblings
seven levels remain reachable in a bounded outline without rendering seven nested forms or rewriting the tree
keyboard-operated purpose groups and advanced disclosure expose layout/export and a working import button
fit-all includes every node and selection focus restores the chosen block without changing selection
390px touch canvas has no minimap overlay; actual taps fit the whole graph and return to the selected node
touch nested edit, undo/redo and text roundtrip preserve sibling conditions and the explicit NOT/unknown explanation
the inspector can return directly to a readable selected block inside the mobile viewport after text/graph switching
primary controls, outline toggles and zoom controls keep 44px tap areas; nested editing has one form, a bounded outline and no horizontal page overflow
saved-rule mobile screenshot retains the parent save/apply/history actions and the edited condition
